titles.romaji: Shiiba-san no Ura no Kao. with Imouto Lip
titles.native: 椎葉さんのウラの顔。with イモートリップ

description:
Shiiba-san no Ura no Kao.
He's always been the quiet kid at school. Never trying to make a fuss, he's barely noticed at all. So why is the prettiest girl in school throwing herself at him... what could the reason be?

Imouto Lip
After returning home he found his younger sister watching porn inside his room, now she wants to try it...
